fpm_php_info_after_trials.source: php-fpm -i after trials; no ini changes during the task; pool overrides in native_configs

protocol.front: the same native Caddy instance: FastCGI to FPM, HTTP to RoadRunner
protocol.runtime_order: FPM then RR on odd trials; RR then FPM on even trials
protocol.rss_definition: sum of resident sets across the selected native server process group; shared mappings may be counted more than once; not PHP heap or unique physical RAM
protocol.cpu_definition: process-group ps CPU time delta, about 0.01 second resolution
protocol.shared_front: Caddy is shared; count its resources once per active runtime scenario
protocol.database_resource_boundary: PostgreSQL is the same isolated Docker fixture for both runtimes; native server-group CPU/RSS excludes the shared database and load client

sql_per_request.kind: declared application SELECT count; excludes connection setup, SET and prepare statements

limitations: loopback development machine with unrelated background processes

small fixture is not evidence of indexed performance on a large catalog
download is a bounded client transfer check, not k6 file throughput
large download client is deliberately paced so RSS can be sampled

native_configs.php-fpm.conf:
[global]
pid = var/catalog-benchmark/fpm.pid
error_log = var/catalog-benchmark/fpm.log
daemonize = no
[catalog]
user = nobody
group = nobody
listen = 127.0.0.1:19201
listen.allowed_clients = 127.0.0.1
pm = static
pm.max_children = 1
pm.max_requests = 0
clear_env = no
catch_workers_output = yes
php_admin_flag[opcache.enable] = on
php_admin_flag[display_errors] = off

version: '3'
server:

  env:
    APP_CONFIG: examples/document-catalog/roadrunner.php
http:
  address: 127.0.0.1:19202
  pool:
    num_workers: 1
logs:
